Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
LOCATION: Bucharest, Romania
 THE ROLE: 
 In our Software Development department, we build applications in the environment of the endpoint management solution. Our developers accompany the entire software development process and are responsible for the development of various front-end, back-end and web applications. They also contribute to discussions about software architecture.
 As a Software Developer Java, you are our specialist in the field of Java and work on projects in back-end mainly.
 TASK AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 
Design complex features with large scope and implement them with the team
Create software architecture proposals for team tasks and discuss them with peers
Lead smaller development projects or feature implementations
Process support requests with high complexity and footprint
Maintain and optimize development and build environment (CI pipelines, release process)
 EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS: 
University degree in computer science, mathematics, IT or relevant professional experience with qualified technical training
Minimum 5 years of professional experience
Expert in object-oriented programming in Java
Experience in using AI in complete development process
Proficient in Spring (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Testing) and JPA
Experienced in service architecture / domain driven design
Good knowledge of development tools (IntelliJ IDEA, Maven, Git).
Knowledge of cloud deployment technologies (Docker)
Knowledge of continuous integration and build & release management
Defines structures and algorithms himself for new types of problems in existing projects
Willing to take project responsibility on a regular basis
Willing to familiarize yourself with new topics and to design and implement new solutions as part of a team
The development of high-quality code is important to you
You have no problem grasping complex contexts and working out content independently
